**What the last experiment taught us:** exp042 trained successfully, but its new raw-feature neighborhood model
scored OOF **0.95807755**, below our four owned inputs, with error correlations **0.977–0.982**.
The reported v45 public score stayed **0.96183**. We preserve that negative result and change the combiner.

- Same **201 pinned inputs**, **699635 training / 299844 test rows**; no new private upload.
- New **direct CUDA XGBoost stacker**,15 leaves, compared with LR/C=.003 on the same frozen-v1 rows.
- Five outer folds; rounds selected on a10% split **inside outer training**, followed by outer-training refit.
- Five predeclared small logit weights; select on paired conditional OOF, never public scores.
- Final independent hybrid CV remains **unknown**: imported base fits are not nested here.

**GPU T4 x2 / one used · Internet off · same11 Inputs/privatev30 as v0.33.**
This trains a new meta learner over existing predictions; it does not retrain201 base models.

### CELL 4 markdown
## 1 · Use the reproducible idea, not somebody else's leaderboard maximum

[ewtherka's family-wise stacker](https://www.kaggle.com/code/ewtherka/s6e10-0-96188-lb-l2-family-wise-actually-helps)
and [goodpjw2008's new noise audit](https://www.kaggle.com/code/goodpjw2008/s6e10-meta-stack-on-public-oof-lb-0-96197)
support testing a nonlinear stacker alongside LR. New public0.96197–0.96198 files also involve
frozen submissions and leaderboard-based choices; those scores are not evidence for a new training recipe.

Our implementation is a **GPU XGBoost adaptation**, not their LightGBM reproduction: binary logloss,
lossguide/15 leaves, eta.03, Hessian min-child100, row/column sampling.8/.5, L2=10.
No rank extrapolation, ready-made high-score CSV, pseudo labels or new family-penalty sweep.

### CELL 8 markdown
## 3 · Train inside the right boundary

For each frozen-v1 fold, both learners see only outer-training targets. The tree uses an inner
stratified10% holdout for early stopping (max4000/patience200); a fresh tree is then refitted on
all outer-training rows for that many rounds. Validation labels never pick that fold's rounds.
Five completed folds retain native trees, LR JSON, IDs, source/environment signatures and predictions.

**Important boundary:** the base library itself was not rebuilt inside those folds. We call the output
**conditional meta OOF**, not clean final-model OOF. The old036 correction is never used as a training
offset or scored as if it were OOF. Outer labels only enter the declared development weight comparison.

Weights `[0,.05,.10,.20,.35]` are fixed before the run. Admit a positive weight only with pooled
conditional AUC gain≥5e-6 and at least4/5 improved folds; ties prefer less tree share.
This is an exploratory development gate, not trusted-v1 promotion. No score from Kaggle enters selection.

### CELL 10 markdown
## 4 · One final recipe, exact export

Refit the final CUDA tree on all training rows for the median inner-selected rounds. Combine
`(1-w)*parent_linear_logit + w*tree_logit + frozen036_correction`, applying the old correction **once**.
Parent full-data LR is the exact verified037 JSON. This is not another residual fit initialized on
target-fitted parent margins. Saved tree inference uses the reloaded native model on CPU for portability;
training configuration proves CUDA was used. One T4 is used, not pooled memory across two cards.

If no positive share passes the conditional gate, `submission.csv` is the **byte-identical parent**;
metrics explicitly say control retained. Do not spend a new submission on the same SHA.
Budget30–120min is unmeasured on Kaggle. A completed fold resumes only in the same working directory
with matching IDs, source, inputs, versions and GPU identity; final all-data fit is repeated on a rerun.
